pages.quiz:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sentence has a preposition of direction? (1 mark)
   A. The children walked along the road.
   B. The bank is near the school.
   C. The cat is under the chair.
   D. The book is on the desk.

2. Which sentence describes a feeling? (1 mark)
   A. I felt proud of our work.
   B. It was Saturday.
   C. We planted five trees.
   D. We swept the paths.

3. In which word does 'gh' say /f/? (1 mark)
   A. daughter
   B. laugh
   C. high
   D. night

4. Target sounds: Which word has the sound /ɜː/? (1 mark)
   A. girl
   B. five
   C. toy
   D. party

5. Which is a negative sentence? (1 mark)
   A. I do not have enough money to buy a bicycle.
   B. I have enough money.
   C. Money is for buying.
   D. I bought a bicycle.

6. Which is correct spelling? (1 mark)
   A. allot of
   B. alot of
   C. a lott of
   D. a lot of

7. What does the proverb 'A friend in need is a friend indeed' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Friends should never ask for help
   B. A friend must be rich
   C. Friends are only for games
   D. A true friend helps you when you are in trouble

8. Which word begins with the sound /ʧ/? (1 mark)
   A. sun
   B. soil
   C. chicken
   D. sack

9. What is hesitation in speaking? (1 mark)
   A. Stopping or saying 'um' and 'er'
   B. Speaking clearly
   C. Speaking loudly
   D. Using gestures

10. 'She sighed with relief' means she (1 mark)
   A. was very angry
   B. was very tired
   C. was afraid
   D. was happy that a worry was over

11. Which word ends with a double consonant? (1 mark)
   A. cla
   B. clas
   C. clasp
   D. class

12. Which pair of words differs only in /h/ and /f/? (1 mark)
   A. sit and seat
   B. ship and sheep
   C. hill and fill
   D. cat and cap

13. What is a caption? (1 mark)
   A. A short line that explains a picture
   B. The last paragraph
   C. The name of the newspaper
   D. A kind of advert

14. Where does the comma go? (1 mark)
   A. Yes, I will help.
   B. Yes I will help,
   C. Yes I will, help.
   D. Yes I, will help.

15. In which word is the letter b silent? (1 mark)
   A. bag
   B. bus
   C. baby
   D. debt

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write a or an before each word: egg, banana, umbrella, hour. (2 marks)

17. Explain why gestures should match your words. (2 marks)

18. Fill in with a, an or the: 'Mama bought ___ cabbage and ___ egg. ___ egg was big.' (3 marks)

19. Fill in the double letters: di__er, ye__ow, bu__on. (3 marks)

20. Write three sentences you would say to report an accident to an adult. (3 marks)

21. Name two visuals you can find in a newspaper. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — The children walked along the road.
   'Along' shows movement.

2. A — I felt proud of our work.
   'Proud' is a feeling.

3. B — laugh
   'Gh' says /f/ in laugh, cough, enough and rough.

4. A — girl
   Girl has the long vowel /ɜː/.

5. A — I do not have enough money to buy a bicycle.
   It says that the money is not sufficient.

6. D — a lot of
   A lot is two words.

7. D — A true friend helps you when you are in trouble
   A true friend is seen when we need help.

8. C — chicken
   'Chicken' begins with 'ch', said /ʧ/.

9. A — Stopping or saying 'um' and 'er'
   Practise to hesitate less.

10. D — was happy that a worry was over
   Relief is the feeling when a worry ends.

11. D — class
   Class ends in ss.

12. C — hill and fill
   'Hill' begins with /h/ and 'fill' with /f/.

13. A — A short line that explains a picture
   A caption describes a picture.

14. A — Yes, I will help.
   A comma follows 'Yes'.

15. D — debt
   'Debt' is said 'det'.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: an egg, a banana, an umbrella, an hour
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each correct answer.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: If they do not match, the listener may be confused about what you mean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for confusion and 1 for a clear reason.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: a, an, The
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct article.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: dinner, yellow, button
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Help! There is an emergency. A boy has fallen and his arm is bleeding. Please bring the first aid kit.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each clear sentence.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Any two: photographs, cartoons, maps, charts, advertisements.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
